verdict.rationale: Cline supports reviewing and reverting individual file edits as diffs (cline-gh-1) and auto-commits work per task-board card (cline-docs-5), giving basic version/rollback of what automations produce. However there's no evidence of versioning the automations themselves (e.g., skills, subagents, cron schedules, MCP configs) with history or rollback of the automation definitions. missing for 10: version history for automation configs/skills/cron jobs, rollback of scheduled/headless automation runs, independent corroboration of rollback workflow.
